intent.goal: Verify sandbox host-service-port access to Redis end-to-end.
intent.acceptance: All three cases in one session, with independently observed sandbox-to-host endpoint binding.

definition.activationRevisionMeaning: Pinned immutable intent-source revision, not a workflow adoption or a claim that the new contract was committed there.

establishedEarlierRules.meaning: Same three host-endpoint Redis cases in readable April 2 source; not proof of operation or complete historical applicability.

historicalApplicability.phenomenon: Redis client/server PING, SET/GET and INFO can be attained by a person or another automation without this workflow.
historicalApplicability.evidenceGap: No contemporaneous independent native operation receipts in the retained input; missing Git contents do not exhaust history.

evidence.opportunity: Independent service/client observations of a Redis test session, regardless of actor.
filters: Count each source-defined case at most once per service lifetime/session.
Use actual completed-operation timestamps in inclusive-start/exclusive-end disjoint event cohorts.
An independently proven partial protocol case does not require all broader safeguards.
Do not accept workflow success, editable issue lineage, agent summaries, digest-shaped flags or declared service health as end-to-end Redis proof.
No restart durability requirement; a GET without an observed preceding successful SET is not a round-trip.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-bound original inputs and source blobs; source-specific native RESP parser. Independent receipt authentication is unavailable in the retained packet and cannot be supplied by caller flags.

model.architecture: Parse native byte-framed Redis exchanges separately from independent receipt admission, endpoint proof and workflow contribution.
model.recommendation: Retain partial proven operations; request only the exact missing run/attempt/service/client receipt endpoints. Do not infer zero or a keep decision.

summary.nativeLabel: Independently verified Redis cases per two-day event cohort

metrics.name: Verified Redis cases
metrics.formula: sum over distinct sessions of independently authenticated PONG, SET/GET round-trip and INFO server cases

metrics.name: Full host-bound integration sessions
metrics.formula: count distinct sessions with all three cases plus independently demonstrated sandbox-to-host.docker.internal:6379 binding

metrics.name: Receipt-linked workflow contributions
metrics.formula: count accepted Redis cases with an independent matching workflow run/head/attempt/client/service receipt

definition.validationLimitation: Synthetic parser examples test arithmetic and protocol handling only. Their purpose and complete content are allowlisted; native collection never imports them or accepts their flags as authority.
rejectedMetrics: Green jobs, reports, issue closure and comments are mechanism/activity signals, not Redis outcomes.
Declared Redis health PING proves neither agent reachability nor SET/GET nor INFO.
TCP connectivity alone is not an application response.
Restart/disk durability would expand the source-defined acceptance and is not measured.

No retained run/attempt/head and protected client/service payload joining receipts for the 17 direct run references. A provider-digest-verified agent ZIP contains parsed Redis tool responses; independent protected host producer corroboration is still missing.

interpretation: Actual standard evaluator rejection retained unchanged. Explicit cutoff snapshot is an unavailable retrospective assessment, not a backdated activation or historical native result.
